name: wlroots
description: Modular library for building Wayland compositors, providing backends (KMS/DRM, libinput, X11, headless), renderers (GLES2, Vulkan, Pixman), and standalone implementations of many Wayland protocol interfaces. Used by Sway, Hyprland (fork), river, and others.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
